title: `SeedMask` is parsed by `SeedMask::new`, not `FromStr`
body:
`SeedMask::new(mask: &str) -> Result<SeedMask>` in `libsufr/src/format.rs` parses a mask of 1s and 0s. It is an inherent constructor, so a caller cannot write `"101".parse::<SeedMask>()` or hand the type to anything generic over `FromStr`.

## Proposal

`impl FromStr for SeedMask` with `type Err = anyhow::Error`, running the check `new` runs today. `SeedMask::new` is removed, and the callers in libsufr, its tests and the CLI call `parse()`.

## Cost

Breaking for library code that calls `SeedMask::new`.
close_reason: Landed in ff48244 on branch `worktree-seed-mask-fromstr`, off dev at 5b90b69. `SeedMask::new` is replaced by `impl FromStr for SeedMask`, and the CHANGELOG records the break. Letting clap parse the CLI flag went to sufr-620f73.
